essence: The wheel is located above a support measuring four finger-breadths addressed to the goddess.
A cluster of signs—trembling, agitation, speech, gesture, and leaping—is enumerated together.
Earth-measure, sky-going, subjugation, and attraction form one enumerated cluster of attainments.
For the beloved, the netherworld and sky-going come to be quickly.
Now another instruction is announced: the resolution of the brahma-knot.
